name: Reputation
oneLiner: Enterprise reputation and customer experience platform (formerly Reputation.com) that combines reviews, listings, surveys, social and AI search visibility for multi-location brands.
bestFor: Multi-location restaurant, hospitality, automotive and healthcare brands that need reviews, surveys and listings managed centrally with enterprise reporting.

updates.text: Expanded the platform with deeper customer insights features.
Unveiled new AI-powered products and features for brand intelligence.
Launched Reputation IQ (plain-English questions across your data), an expanded AI Reputation Manager (how ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity present your brand) and AI Location Presence Insights.

features: Review monitoring and response across Google, Yelp, Facebook, Tripadvisor and other sites from one inbox
Review requests by SMS, email and QR code, triggered by dine-in, delivery or POS events
Surveys and customer feedback alongside public reviews
Sentiment and text analytics that group feedback into themes such as service or cleanliness
AI search visibility tools: AI Reputation Manager and AI Location Presence Insights
Reputation IQ for asking questions of your feedback data in plain English
RepScore: an AI-driven score for each location and region
Competitive Insights: benchmark ratings, themes and response times against nearby restaurants (add-on)
Actions and ticketing to route issues to the right team (add-on)
Food and beverage page: AI Reputation Manager structures menus, hours, photos and attributes so locations show up in AI recommendations and 'near me' discovery
Reviews + Surveys: feedback collected by SMS, QR code or email, capturing item-level and service feedback
Listings + Local SEO: menus, hours and specials kept current across Google, Yelp and AI overviews

pricing.text: Published per-location prices: Rep Core $80 per location per month (reviews management with AI responding, listings and SEO); Rep Core + Pulse $115 (adds Rep Score, Journey Insights, AI Reputation Manager, Pulse analytics, 1 basic survey template); Rep Core + Surveys $150 (6 custom survey templates, email survey requests, outreach campaigns); Enterprise custom for 125+ locations. Add-ons priced on request: Competitive Insights, Actions & Ticketing, Social Suite, Premium Sources (Yelp, Tripadvisor and others), Premium Integrations, managed services.

notes: Rebranded from Reputation.com to Reputation; still uses the reputation.com domain, HQ San Ramon, CA; marked its 20th year in March 2026. No acquisition of the company found. A CostBench page claims public plans of $80–$150/month and a February 2026 price cut; not confirmed on reputation.com and inconsistent with its enterprise sales model, so left out. Mitchells & Butlers case study dates from 2018. Dropped from the current review: the claim that its portfolio is 'primarily healthcare' (it also targets hospitality, automotive and others; not re-checked). Also copied to reputation-com.json. November 2026: reputation.com/pricing now publishes per-location prices ($80, $115, $150 and custom Enterprise), so the earlier 'custom pricing only' line is replaced; no trial or billing term is stated. Restaurant results from reputation.com/solutions/industries/food-beverage (vendor-reported). G2 rating (4.5, 2,468 reviews) from G2 search result snippets; G2 blocked fetching.

results.text: Mitchells & Butlers: star rating across the group up from 3.7 to 4.2, guest feedback unified across 1,600+ locations and 15+ brands, 93% of inbound feedback answered
Tortilla: +38% views; became the UK's highest-rated burrito chain

pros: Built for multi-location restaurant groups, corporate or franchised
AI review responding is included from the entry plan
Surveys, reviews, listings and AI search visibility in one platform
Published per-location prices for the core plans
Restaurant results such as Mitchells & Butlers (3.7 to 4.2 stars across the group)

cons.text: Yelp, Tripadvisor and other industry sites are Premium Sources, an add-on
Social Suite, Actions & Ticketing and Competitive Insights are paid add-ons
Priced per location per month, so cost grows with every location; custom plans for 125+ locations
Surveys are limited to 1 basic template below the $150 Rep Core + Surveys plan
No self-serve signup; every plan goes through a sales call
